# core-cenf-py

> Python 3.12+ infrastructure library. 22 managers. Clean Architecture (Ports & Adapters). Zero domain logic.

## Quick Install

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/CENFARG/core-cenf-py.git
pip install "core-cenf[sqlalchemy] @ git+https://github.com/CENFARG/core-cenf-py.git"
pip install "core-cenf[all] @ git+https://github.com/CENFARG/core-cenf-py.git"
```

## Golden Rule

Depend on Protocols, inject Adapters. Never import adapters in business logic.

```python
# CORRECT
from core_infrastructure.config.ports import ConfigManager
# WRONG
from core_infrastructure.config.adapters.pydantic_config_adapter import PydanticConfigAdapter
```

## File Structure

```
src/core_infrastructure/
├── bootstrap.py              BootstrapOrchestrator (lifecycle)
├── alert/                    M15 — Slack/Discord/Email alerts
├── auth/                     M06 — JWT validation (HS256)
├── bus_event/                M21 — Pub/sub messaging (NATS, Redis, Memory)
├── cache/                    M07 — KV cache with stampede protection
├── common/                   Shared: contextvars, errors, base models
├── config/                   M01 — Read-only YAML+env config
├── database/                 M08 — SQLAlchemy 2.0+ async transactions
├── dependency/               M13 — Lazy safe import resolution
├── dynamic_prompting/        M14 — Conditional prompt assembly
├── errors/                   M04 — Classify & report errors
├── external_api/             M11 — Resilient HTTP with circuit breaker
├── feature_flags/            M12 — Runtime toggles (YAML→Unleash)
├── filestorage/              M09 — Multi-cloud blob storage (S3, GCS, Azure)
├── i18n/                     M17 — Multi-language translations
├── licence/                  M19 — Signed licence validation
├── logger/                   M02 — Structured logging
├── observability/            M05 — OTel RED metrics & tracing
├── permission/               M18 — RBAC+ABAC access control
├── ratelimit/                M16 — Token bucket rate limiting
├── secrets/                  M03 — Encrypted credential storage
├── state_machine/            M22 — State machine (guards, hooks, errors)
├── taskqueue/                M10 — Async jobs with DLQ (SAQ)
└── update/                   M20 — Desktop auto-update + rollback
```

## Manager Reference

| # | Manager | Protocol | Test Adapter | Production Adapter |
|---|---------|----------|-------------|-------------------|
| M01 | ConfigManager | `config.ports.ConfigManager` | `InMemoryConfigAdapter` | `PydanticConfigAdapter` |
| M02 | LoggerManager | `logger.ports.LoggerManager` | `InMemoryLoggerAdapter` | `StructlogAdapter` |
| M03 | SecretManager | `secrets.ports.SecretManager` | `InMemorySecretAdapter` | `EncryptedSecretAdapter` |
| M04 | ErrorHandlingManager | `errors.ports.ErrorHandlingManager` | `CapturingErrorAdapter` | (decorator-based) |
| M05 | ObservabilityManager | `observability.ports.ObservabilityManager` | `InMemoryObservabilityAdapter` | `OTelAdapter` |
| M06 | AuthManager | `auth.ports.AuthManager` | `StaticAuthAdapter` | `JwtAuthAdapter` |
| M07 | CacheManager | `cache.ports.CacheManager` | `MemoryCacheAdapter` | `RedisCacheAdapter` |
| M08 | DatabaseManager | `database.ports.DatabaseManager` | `MemoryDatabaseAdapter` | `SQLAlchemyAdapter` |
| M09 | FileStorageManager | `filestorage.ports.FileStorageManager` | `MemoryStorageAdapter` | `S3StorageAdapter`, `GcsStorageAdapter`, `AzureStorageAdapter` |
| M10 | TaskQueueManager | `taskqueue.ports.TaskQueueManager` | `MemoryTaskQueueAdapter` | `SaQAdapter` |
| M11 | ExternalAPIManager | `external_api.ports.ExternalAPIManager` | `MockHTTPAdapter` | `ResilientHTTPAdapter` |
| M12 | FeatureFlagManager | `feature_flags.ports.FeatureFlagManager` | `MemoryFeatureFlagAdapter` | (Unleash TBD) |
| M13 | DependencyManager | `dependency.ports.DependencyManager` | `InMemoryDependencyAdapter` | (runtime) |
| M14 | DynamicPromptingManager | `dynamic_prompting.ports.DynamicPromptingManager` | (use real) | (runtime) |
| M15 | AlertManager | `alert.ports.AlertManager` | (use real) | `SlackAdapter`, `DiscordAdapter` |
| M16 | RateLimiterManager | `ratelimit.ports.RateLimiterManager` | `InMemoryRateLimitAdapter` | (Redis TBD) |
| M17 | I18nManager | `i18n.ports.I18nManager` | `InMemoryI18nAdapter` | (I18next TBD) |
| M18 | PermissionManager | `permission.ports.PermissionManager` | `InMemoryPermissionAdapter` | `CasbinPermissionAdapter` |
| M19 | LicenceManager | `licence.ports.LicenceManager` | `InMemoryLicenceAdapter` | (runtime) |
| M20 | UpdateManager | `update.ports.UpdateManager` | `InMemoryUpdateAdapter` | (runtime) |
| M21 | BusEventManager | `bus_event.ports.BusEventManager` | `MemoryBusAdapter` | `NatsBusAdapter`, `RedisBusAdapter` |
| M22 | StateMachineManager | `state_machine.ports.StateMachineManager` | `InMemoryStateMachineAdapter` | (runtime) |

## Bootstrap Pattern

```python
import asyncio
from core_infrastructure.bootstrap import BootstrapOrchestrator
from core_infrastructure.config.adapters.in_memory_config_adapter import InMemoryConfigAdapter
from core_infrastructure.logger.adapters.in_memory_logger_adapter import InMemoryLoggerAdapter

async def main():
    config = InMemoryConfigAdapter({"app.name": "my-app", "app.env": "dev"})
    logger = InMemoryLoggerAdapter(config_manager=config)
    orchestrator = BootstrapOrchestrator(config, logger)
    await orchestrator.run()

asyncio.run(main())
```

## Import Safety (Lazy Loading)

Optional adapters gracefully degrade to `None` when dependencies are missing:

```python
from core_infrastructure.database import SQLAlchemyAdapter

if SQLAlchemyAdapter is None:
    db = MemoryDatabaseAdapter(config, logger)  # fallback for dev/testing
else:
    db = SQLAlchemyAdapter(config, logger)       # production
```

| Symbol | When None | Fix |
|--------|-----------|-----|
| `SQLAlchemyAdapter` | sqlalchemy missing | `pip install core-cenf[sqlalchemy]` |
| `SaQAdapter` | saq missing | `pip install core-cenf[saq]` |
| `S3StorageAdapter` | aioboto3 missing | `pip install core-cenf[s3]` |
| `RedisCacheAdapter` | redis missing | `pip install core-cenf[all]` |

## Context Propagation (IMPLICIT)

```python
from core_infrastructure.common import context
context.set_correlation_id("req-123")
context.set_tenant_id("cntrs")
# NEVER pass context as function arguments — use contextvars
```

## Error Taxonomy

- `TransientError` — retryable (network timeout, DB deadlock)
- `PermanentError` — not retryable (missing resource, invalid config)
- `ValidationError` — schema violation (Pydantic)
- `AuthError` — expired token, wrong signature
- `RateLimitError` — bucket exhausted

## Testing

```python
config = InMemoryConfigAdapter({"db.host": "localhost"})
logger = InMemoryLoggerAdapter(config_manager=config)
# All managers have InMemory adapters for zero-dependency testing
```

## CI/CD Gate

```bash
ruff check src/ tests/         # ZERO errors
mypy src/core_infrastructure/ --strict  # ZERO errors
python -m pytest tests/ -q     # ALL green
```
